**Garlic Tomato Gluten-Free Pasta-Style Dinner**  
A quick gluten-free pasta-style dinner with a silky tomato sauce and vegetables.

**Ingredients for 2 servings**
- 180 g gluten-free pasta
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1 onion
- 250 g cherry tomatoes
- 1 tbsp tomato paste
- 60 g spinach
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 pinch black pepper
- 30 g parmesan

**Method**
- Cook the gluten-free pasta in salted water until tender, then drain.
- Warm the olive oil in a pan and cook the onion for a few minutes until softened.
- Add the garlic and cook briefly, then stir in the cherry tomatoes and tomato paste.
- Cook until the tomatoes break down into a saucy mix, then add the spinach and let it wilt.
- Toss the sauce with the drained pasta, season with salt and pepper, and finish with parmesan.

BBQ Chicken Thighs with Corn and Sweet Potato [american-bbq-chicken-traybake] for 6 servings:

- 1200 g chicken thighs
- 1050 g sweet potatoes
- 900 g sweetcorn
- 3 tbsp olive oil
- 2.25 tsp salt
- 1.5 tsp black pepper
- 1.5 tsp paprika
- 1.5 tsp garlic powder
- 180 ml ketchup
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 1.5 tbsp cider vinegar
- 1.5 tsp mustard
- 3 tbsp water

Per serving: 650 kcal, 48 g protein, 81 g carbs, 17 g fat.

Method:
1. Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a large baking tray with baking paper if you have it.
2. Cut the sweet potatoes into bite-sized chunks. Toss them with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Spread them on the tray and roast for 15 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, mix the ketchup, brown sugar, cider vinegar, mustard, water, paprika, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt in a bowl to make the barbecue sauce.
4. Pat the chicken thighs dry, season with the remaining salt and pepper, then toss with the barbecue sauce until well coated.
5. Remove the tray from the oven, add the sweetcorn and chicken thighs, and turn the sweet potatoes. Drizzle the sweetcorn with the remaining olive oil.
6. Return to the oven and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, the juices run clear, and the sweet potatoes are browned at the edges.
7. If you want a stickier glaze, brush the chicken with any extra sauce and roast for 3 to 5 minutes more. Serve the chicken with the roasted sweet potato and sweetcorn.

Baking soda and baking powder are both leaveners, but they work differently:

- **Baking soda** is pure sodium bicarbonate. It needs an **acid** in the batter or dough to react, like yogurt, buttermilk, lemon juice, vinegar, brown sugar, or molasses. It makes bubbles fast.
- **Baking powder** already contains both the **base and the acid** it needs, so it can rise on its own once mixed with liquid and heat.

Quick rule:
- Use **baking soda** when the recipe has an acidic ingredient.
- Use **baking powder** when it doesn’t, or if the recipe specifically calls for it.

A common detail:
- **Baking powder** is usually “double-acting,” meaning it gives some rise when mixed and more in the oven.
- **Baking soda** is stronger, so too much can leave a soapy or bitter taste.

If you want, I can also tell you how to substitute one for the other in a recipe.

Chocolate Cake

Ingredients for 8 servings:
- 200 g plain flour
- 50 g cocoa powder
- 200 g sugar
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 pinch salt
- 2 eggs
- 240 ml milk
- 120 ml vegetable oil
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 240 ml boiling water
- 100 g butter
- 200 g icing sugar
- 50 g dark chocolate

Method:
- Heat the oven to 175°C and grease and line two 20 cm cake tins.
- Mix the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl.
- Add the eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla, then beat until smooth.
- Stir in the boiling water slowly; the batter will be thin.
- Divide the batter between the tins and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
- Let the cakes cool in the tins for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely.
- Melt the dark chocolate and let it cool slightly.
- Beat the butter and icing sugar until light, then mix in the melted chocolate to make the frosting.
- Sandwich the cakes together with frosting, then spread the remaining frosting over the top and sides.

Vegan Chocolate Cake

Ingredients for 8 servings:
- 250 g plain flour
- 200 g sugar
- 50 g cocoa powder
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 pinch salt
- 250 ml plant milk
- 120 ml vegetable oil
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 tbsp white vinegar
- 250 ml hot water

Method:
- Heat the oven to 180°C and line or grease a cake tin.
- In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
- Add the plant milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, and vinegar, then mix until just combined.
- Stir in the hot water until the batter is smooth and fairly thin.
- Pour into the prepared tin and bake for about 30 to 35 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
- Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely before slicing.

Classic Beef Lasagne

A rich, layered beef lasagne with tomato sauce, creamy béchamel, and plenty of cheese. It bakes into a comforting, classic family dinner.

Ingredients for 6 servings:
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 onion
- 3 garlic cloves
- 500 g beef mince
- 1 carrot
- 2 celery sticks
- 800 g tinned chopped tomatoes
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 250 ml beef stock
- 2 tsp dried oregano
- 1 tsp dried basil
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 60 g butter
- 60 g plain flour
- 750 ml milk
- 1 pinch nutmeg
- 12 lasagne sheets
- 50 g parmesan
- 200 g mozzarella

Method:
- Heat the oven to 190°C. Finely chop the onion, garlic, carrot, and celery.
- Warm the olive oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
- Add the beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
- Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, beef stock, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper. Simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes until thick.
- To make the béchamel, melt the butter in a saucepan. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk until smooth, then cook, stirring, until thick. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
- Spread a thin layer of meat sauce in a baking dish. Add a layer of lasagne sheets, then more meat sauce, then béchamel. Repeat the layers, finishing with béchamel on top.
- Sprinkle over the parmesan and mozzarella. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

Yes — here’s a simple Banana Bread recipe:

**Ingredients**
- 3 ripe bananas
- 250 g plain flour
- 100 g sugar
- 75 g butter
- 2 eggs
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1 pinch salt
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Method**
- Heat the oven to 175°C and grease or line a loaf tin.
- Mash the bananas in a bowl until mostly smooth.
- Melt the butter, then whisk it with the sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
- Stir in the mashed bananas.
- Add the flour, baking powder, and salt, then mix just until combined.
- Pour the batter into the tin and smooth the top.
- Bake for 50 to 55 minutes, until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
- Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool fully before slicing.
